name: design-to-code
description: Root orchestration package for the design-to-code docker stack

scripts.setup: npm run util:install && npm run util:build-env:local && npm run start
scripts.start: npm run stop && npm run start:dev
scripts.stop: if [ -f docker-compose.yaml ]; then docker compose down --remove-orphans --volumes; fi && docker network prune -f
scripts.compose:build: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local build app relay nginx cache && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file .env.local build
scripts.start:dev: npm run start:reverse-proxy && ./docker-compose-generator.sh && npm run compose:build && npm run compose:up && npm run util:is-ready
scripts.start:prod: npm run start:reverse-proxy && ./docker-compose-generator.sh --prod && npm run compose:build && npm run compose:up && npm run util:is-ready
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f app relay nginx cache
